entries.failure_condition_en: Personal privacy/classified/non-public data appears, or conceptual recommendations are presented as settled government decisions

entries.requirement_en: International communication: raise global attention & recognition of the belt

entries.failure_condition_en: English counterparts (proposal.en.md / index.en.html / figure .en) are missing or substantively unequal to Chinese

entries.requirement_en: Long-term operation value: sediment brand assets, event mechanisms & cooperation channels
entries.section_zh: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
entries.failure_condition_zh: 未沉淀为一带长期品牌资产/活动机制/合作通道中的任何一项
entries.failure_condition_en: None of long-term brand assets / event mechanisms / cooperation channels is established
